_convergence_criteria.description: Converges when: external research cycle design stabilizes. Models agree on Ouroboros architecture.
_convergence_criteria.primary: gamma >= 0.40 AND 2 consecutive rounds with 0 novel research-cycle proposals
_convergence_criteria.secondary: 3+ rounds with no new provenance or evidence-path mechanism proposed
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: No convergence on Ouroboros design by wall clock cap
